Pronounce each word, give the definition, then ask the question."},{"type":"teacher-script","move":"teach","text":"Group 1: *mystified* means completely puzzled. *Impending* means about to happen, usually something threatening. *Uneasiness* is a worried feeling that something is wrong. *Disoriented* means confused about where you are or what is going on. Characters who have just left the Underworld could feel any of these."},{"type":"teacher-script","move":"ask","text":"Which word fits best for someone who knows a dangerous event is coming but cannot tell when? Disoriented is when you feel lost or dizzy about where you are or what is real."},{"type":"teacher-script","move":"teach","text":"Group 2: *trust* is firm belief that someone is honest and reliable. *Sacrifice* is giving up something valuable for others. *Fulfillment* is the satisfaction of reaching a goal or purpose. *Revelation* is a surprising truth suddenly made known. These are theme words, so we will use them to name big ideas in the story."},{"type":"teacher-script","move":"ask","text":"Which of these four words could name something Percy gives up for his mother? Explain."},{"type":"sample-response","text":"Sacrifice. Notice there is no I think or I like."},{"type":"paragraph","audience":"shared","text":"Model: In Chapter 20, Percy and Annabeth plan their next move after the Underworld, which shows the theme of trust because Percy accepts Annabeth's strategy."},{"type":"directions","text":"Write a 3–4 sentence summary of pp. 320–326. I use words like the text shows instead of I feel."},{"type":"teacher-script","move":"ask","text":"What central idea about betrayal and loyalty do the characters' actions develop together?"},{"type":"sample-response","text":"After a betrayal-filled trial, loyalty to friends and family becomes the most important thing.
